WINNER: cohort_anchor_32
FIRST LISTED: cohort_anchor_32
ARGUMENT: behavior_evidence: the frozen bundle supports a real prefix-survival/branching problem (E6) and a train-only, nondegenerate cohort signal (E9); A explicitly uses predecessor-cohort distributions in the assignment objective. geometry_necessity and implementability: A specifies curved anchor-to-prototype distance in the actual assignment (E12–E15) and retains Euclidean residuals. Exploration_value: the 32-way capacity premise is empirically motivated (E8), and A proposes testing gold-prefix survival, T4 NLL, and Stage3 recall, so a negative result would directly test whether cohort-guided curved anchors help.
